name: gp66-leopard
source: SteelSeries GG USBPcap capture on this machine (newcap.pcap)
notes: Measured from SteelSeries GG USB captures on the GP66 Leopard 11UG (1038:113a), not inherited from another model. GG addresses 96 MSI keycodes; this map names the 86 of them that reference-gs65 could name (plus fn=240). The 17 GS65 numpad keycodes 83-99 never appear on this keyboard and were dropped. Keycodes 50, 102, 135-139, 144 and 145 exist here but have no X11 name in the reference map, so they are listed under unnamed_msi and addressed as msi<code>; identify them with 'msikb verify --keymap gp66-leopard'. Region frame sizes observed on this machine: 42 (alphanum), 24 (modifiers), 19 (numpad), 11 (enter).
